risk_free_rate.note: The U.S. Treasury curve has no Veterans Day observation. November 10 was the latest available 10-year par yield before the November 12 equity market open.

equity_risk_premium.note: Trailing 12-month implied U.S. equity risk premium with adjusted payout. The estimate uses the Treasury-yield convention. The model carries this dated estimate into the November 12 cutoff and uses the latest available Treasury yield.

unlevered_beta.note: NYU's January 2026 cash-adjusted unlevered beta for the 19-company U.S. Transportation group serves as a broad proxy for parcel and logistics business risk. The date represents a month-level source. Re-lever with the observed FDX equity market cap, September carrying debt including finance leases, and the model tax rate. The peer group includes different transport businesses.

pretax_cost_of_debt.note: Effective yield released at 8:51 a.m. ET on November 12 before the 9:30 a.m. equity open. This broad USD BBB index proxies marginal funding cost for FedEx's disclosed BBB/Baa2 senior unsecured ratings. The dated September FedEx 2036 notes issuance provides a company-specific cross-check.

tax_rate.note: Use the CY2026 adjusted effective rate as the model's forward and tax-shield assumption. The issuer forecast excludes specified mark-to-market effects and the Supply Chain deferred tax benefit. Extending it into the forecast and perpetuity is an analyst assumption.

terminal_growth.note: Analyst assumption for nominal steady-state growth of FedEx operating profit. The FOMC's longer-run medians were 2% PCE inflation and 2% real U.S. GDP growth. The selected rate allows modest real growth for a mature network.

terminal_return_on_new_invested_capital.note: Use FedEx's approximate 2029 company-wide ROIC target as a proxy for terminal marginal return on new operating capital. The target describes average invested capital. The marginal interpretation is an analyst assumption. Terminal reinvestment equals first terminal-year NOPAT multiplied by terminal growth divided by this return.

debt_cross_check.note: The reoffer yield reflects September pricing. Applying the original 95 bp spread to the latest Treasury par yield would imply 5.93% as a second funding-cost proxy. Current pricing for this specific issue was unavailable.

notes: Equity weights use quoted market capitalization. Debt uses filed carrying value, including finance leases. Operating leases stay in operating costs and outside the debt weights.
The equity beta and bond yield are proxy inputs with different market scopes and observation dates.
The terminal growth and marginal return assumptions are adjustable. Sensitivities recalculate reinvestment at each growth rate.
